n:Ministry of Finance of Venezuela: The Ministry of Finance of Venezuela is the Venezuelan government's finance ministry, based in Caracas. Its link to the Central Bank of Venezuela is a shared official. Nelson Merentes, president of the central bank since 2009, moved from that post to become Minister of Finance in the government of Venezuela. That is the tie on record: one person holding the top job at the central bank and then the ministry.
n:Ministry of Finance of the Maldives: The Ministry of Finance of the Maldives is the Maldivian government's finance ministry, based in Malé. It is tied to the Maldives Monetary Authority, the country's central bank, through a shared official. Ali Hashim served as the government's finance minister and was then nominated, in August 2019, to be Governor of the Monetary Authority. At the time of reporting he was the nominee rather than the sitting governor.
n:Nepal Investment Board: The Nepal Investment Board is a state body in Kathmandu. It shares an official with Nepal Rastra Bank, the country's central bank. Maha Prasad Adhikari retired as deputy governor of the bank in December 2015, after three decades there, and became chief executive officer of the Investment Board. He then returned to the central bank as its seventeenth governor, appointed on 6 April 2020 for a five-year term.
n:New Zealand Superannuation Fund: The New Zealand Superannuation Fund is a state investment body based in Auckland. It shares an official with the Reserve Bank of New Zealand, the country's central bank. Adrian Orr had moved from chief economist at the bank Westpac to Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank, and later came from the Superannuation Fund to become Governor of the Reserve Bank from 27 March 2018.
n:Office of the Auditor General of Beliz: The Office of the Auditor General of Belize, in Belmopan, audits government accounts. For the 2011/2012 financial year it reported that the Treasury could not show that 25 bank accounts held by the Central Bank of Belize for the Government of Belize had been reconciled for the period audited. It also found the Commonwealth Secretariat public debt recording system run by the central bank did not match the Accountant General's statements, and that interest payments recorded by the central bank differed from the government's Smart Stream records.
n:PASHA Bank: PASHA Bank is a commercial bank in Baku, Azerbaijan. It shares an official with the Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Taleh Kazimov rose at PASHA Bank from risk manager to chief executive officer and then chairman, before being made Governor of the central bank by a parliamentary vote reported on 18 April 2022. The move from the bank to the governorship is the tie here.
n:ProCredit Holding AG: ProCredit Holding AG is a company based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It shares an official with the National Bank of Georgia, Georgia's central bank. Nino Jeladze came from JSC ProCredit Bank Georgia and ProCredit Holding in Frankfurt to the National Bank of Georgia, where she became Head of the Supervisory Policy Department in 2024 and then Vice-Governor and a member of the Board on 10 February 2025.
n:Raiffeisen Bank Albania: Raiffeisen Bank Albania is a commercial bank in Tirana. It shares an official with the Bank of Albania, the country's central bank. Gent Sejko held senior executive and committee-chairing roles at the National Commercial Bank, the American Bank of Albania and Raiffeisen Bank, and came from being Deputy General Manager of Societe Generale Albania to be Governor of the Bank of Albania and Chairman of its Supervisory Council on 5 February 2015.
n:Raiffeisen Bank d.d. Bosna i Hercegovi: Raiffeisen Bank d.d. Bosna i Hercegovina is a commercial bank in Sarajevo. It shares an official with the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Jasmina Selimovic was an independent member of the Supervisory Board of Raiffeisen Bank BiH in 2018, and joined the central bank's Governing Board on 3 January 2024, later becoming Governor and chair of that board. She had also been president of the board of directors of the Sarajevo Canton Institute of Health Insurance since 2021.
Raiffeisenbank a.s. is a commercial bank in Prague, Czechia. It shares an official with the Czech National Bank. Aleš Michl worked at Raiffeisenbank as an economist and investment strategist, then joined the Czech National Bank's board in December 2018 and later became its governor. The move from the commercial bank into the central bank's board and then its top job is what connects the two.
n:Royal Government of Bhutan: The Royal Government of Bhutan, in Thimphu, appoints and can direct the board of the Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan, the country's central bank. Under the Royal Monetary Authority Act of Bhutan 2010, in force from 22 June 2010, section 149 lets the government issue such directives to the Authority as it considers necessary, after consulting the Governor and in the public interest, reporting them to Parliament. Four of the board's seven members are government appointees, one from the Ministry of Finance, and the government sets the Governor's salary.
n:Sarajevo Canton Institute of Health In: The Sarajevo Canton Institute of Health Insurance is a state body in Sarajevo, Bosnia. It shares an official with the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Jasmina Selimovic has been president of the Institute's board of directors since 2021, and went from there to the central bank's Governing Board, which she joined on 3 January 2024, later becoming Governor and chair of the board. She had earlier been an independent member of the Supervisory Board of Raiffeisen Bank BiH in 2018.
n:Senate of Rwanda: The Senate of Rwanda is one chamber of the country's parliament, in Kigali. It summoned Claver Gatete, governor of the National Bank of Rwanda, over the slide of the Rwandan franc, which had weakened 1.3 percent against the dollar in the first half of the year. Gatete appeared with finance minister John Rwangombwa and put the pressure down to speculation by investors who heard donors were cutting aid, saying the central bank had put 327.8 million US dollars into the foreign exchange market since 2011.
n:Societe Generale Albania: Societe Generale Albania is a commercial bank in Tirana. It shares an official with the Bank of Albania, the country's central bank. Gent Sejko moved from Deputy General Manager at Societe Generale Albania to Governor of the Bank of Albania and Chairman of its Supervisory Council on 5 February 2015, and was re-elected for a second term on 24 February 2022. Before that he had held senior executive and committee-chairing roles at the National Commercial Bank, the American Bank of Albania and Raiffeisen Bank.
n:Stanbic Bank Zambia: Stanbic Bank Zambia is a commercial bank in Zambia; the map marker sits on the country rather than the exact office. It shares an official with the Bank of Zambia, the country's central bank. Dr Austin Mwape was Deputy Governor of Operations at the Bank of Zambia and then became chairman of the board of directors of Stanbic Bank Zambia from December 2016.
n:State Bank of Mongolia: The State Bank of Mongolia is a state-owned commercial bank in Ulaanbaatar. It shares an official with the Bank of Mongolia, the country's central bank. Enkhjargal Danzanbaljir was Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mongolia from 2007 to 2010 and its London representative, then worked at the Asian Development Bank, the World Bank, the AIIB, the International Investment Bank and the State Bank of Mongolia, before returning to the central bank's Supervisory Board as a member in 2025.
n:Stephen Tiroyakgosi: Stephen Tiroyakgosi heads Botswana's Directorate of Public Prosecutions, in Gaborone. In that role he called in Moses Pelaelo, governor of the Bank of Botswana, to hear his account of the 100 billion pula the state alleged had been taken from the central bank by former president Ian Khama and former intelligence chief Isaac Kgosi. Tiroyakgosi said Pelaelo told them no money was missing from the Bank of Botswana. The allegation is unproven and the investigation was continuing.
n:Stopanska Banka AD Skopje: Stopanska Banka AD Skopje is a commercial bank in Skopje, North Macedonia, and a member of the NBG Group. It shares an official with the National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia. Dimitar Bogov was the bank's chief economist from 2002 to January 2007, then Vice Governor of the central bank from February 2007 to May 2011, and Governor from 2011.
n:Swedbank AB: Swedbank AB is a commercial bank in Stockholm, Sweden. It shares an official with Sveriges Riksbank, Sweden's central bank. Anna Breman was a senior economist at Swedbank from 2013 to 2015 and its group chief economist from 2015 to 2019, then became a Deputy Governor of the Riksbank from 2019 to 2022 and First Deputy Governor from 2022.
n:Teresita Miranda: Teresita Miranda, in Belmopan, is named in a documented matter involving the Central Bank of Belize. The Joint Public Accounts Committee of Belize's National Assembly, reporting on the Auditor General's report for April 2016 to March 2017, listed significant material differences between Central Bank and SmartStream balances as a priority area, with gaps of 42 million, 19 million, 3 million and 1.4 million dollars. It recorded that the 19,489,652.02 dollar gap for the Debt Service Escrow Account was a typing error, which the Auditor General confirmed.
n:Treasury Department, Government of Bel: The Treasury Department of the Government of Belize, in Belmopan, is named in an audit finding involving the Central Bank of Belize. For the 2011/2012 financial year the Auditor General of Belize reported that the Treasury could not show that 25 bank accounts held by the central bank on the government's behalf had been reconciled for the period audited. The same report found that interest payments recorded by the central bank differed from those in the government's Smart Stream system. No amounts were given for the findings.
n:United National Bank Limited: United National Bank Limited is a bank in London, United Kingdom. It shares an official with the State Bank of Pakistan, Pakistan's central bank. Yaseen Anwar worked at Bank of America from 1976 to 1991 and as a vice president at Merrill Lynch from 1992 to 2001, and was a non-executive director of United National Bank from 2000 to 2006. He was appointed Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan on 29 March 2007 and Governor on 19 October 2011.
n:Valentinas Mazuronis: Valentinas Mazuronis, in Vilnius, chaired a Lithuanian parliamentary commission that examined the Bank of Lithuania's closure of the bank Snoras in November 2011. The commission found the central bank had acted too fast and with too little reasoning. Mazuronis said the takeover of Snoras shares in the public interest and the opening of bankruptcy proceedings were both hasty and not sufficiently reasoned. This was the commission's own finding about the central bank's handling of the shutdown.
n:Westpac Banking Corporation: Westpac Banking Corporation is a bank based in Sydney, Australia. It shares an official with the Reserve Bank of New Zealand, New Zealand's central bank. Adrian Orr was Westpac's chief economist before becoming Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank, and later came from the New Zealand Superannuation Fund to be Governor of the Reserve Bank from 27 March 2018.
